text:
ella: Heads-up: our new "next-agent-composable" sample is flaking in CI. Eval harness reports mismatched ranks for RAG scoring.
tomas: repro steps? which part of the stack?
ella: embeddings look reordered intermittently when requests hit the JS SDK batching+retry path. Also saw a 401 mid-batch when key rotated, triggering a partial retry and a duplicate id in the response set.
ryan: that's nasty. Which SDK versions and sample dir?
ella: @tomas the sample uses `@redwood/sdk@0.9.3` (Node). Path: samples/next-agent-composable. Python SDK consumers (redwood==0.9.0) don't show the issue.
nikita: do you have logs?
ella: small excerpt: 
```
batch request ids: [q1,q2,q3,q4]
responses arrived: [q1,q3,q2]  // q4 missing
retry triggered for chunk 2 -> returned: [q2]
final merged responses: [q1,q3,q2,q2] // q2 duplicated, q4 missing
```
ryan: looks like retry merge doesn't dedupe by client id and ordering isn't restored. For deterministic evals we need both.
tomas: could be two bugs: (1) unordered fill of results as promises resolve, and (2) retry merge appends rather than re-inserts in original position.
nikita: temporary sample fix?
ella: added a tiny post-process in `api/embeds.ts`: map results by `itemId`, then reassemble in original order; also dedupe by `itemId` before returning to harness. Put `SAMPLE_STABLE_EMBEDS=true` in `.env` so CI picks it up.
ryan: opened SDK issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/1207 - "JS SDK: batch retry merge should dedupe + preserve input order". Labelled sdk, parity, high.
deploy-bot: issue #1207 created by ryan  labels: sdk,parity,high
tomas: assign to eng-ml to prioritize. For SDK change options: 1) internal placeholder array + fill by index, 2) require user-provided id and always return sorted by that id, 3) add opt-in flag `preserveOrder:true` that costs a tiny perf hit.
nikita: prefer opt-in for now with default preserveOrder=true to match python parity. Also ensure retry path checks client-supplied id and dedupes.
ryan: I'll prototype an SDK patch doing placeholder-array+dedupe and run microbenchmarks at 200 qps. If overhead <5% we can keep as default.
ella: once SDK PR lands I'll remove SAMPLE_STABLE_EMBEDS and update sample README with a note about ordering assumptions. Also adding an eval harness test that asserts: same ids, same cardinality, and stable ordering.
tomas: thanks. In the meantime, add a small harness guard that de-dupes and sorts deterministically so CI isn't flaky. Make a short internal note in devex checklist about key rotation causing partial batch failures.
nikita: also add a unit in the SDK tests that simulates an auth failure mid-batch and asserts the merge logic is correct.
ryan: PR coming for samples and a separate PR for SDK.
ella: sample PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/pull/4110 (env flag + reorder helper).
tomas: good, let's track progress in the SDK issue and add the harness integration test to prevent regressions. :thumbsup:
